reasons: Datadog sum:system.net.bytes_sent with no grouping maps to a cross-series sum of OTel system.network.io transmit bytes, matching the candidate's sum() with no by-clause.
The direction filter system_network_direction="transmit" uses a label observed in the dataset, so the matcher is valid and selects the transmit side of the counter.
Unit is bytes in both (OTel unit By), and rate() is applied only to a monotonic sum, which is allowed; the per-second display in the widget title supports the rate().
The template variable $scope has no prefix and default *, so dropping it (all series) is correct.
Outcome translated is correct since no function or missing metric mapping blocks the request.
